data.rationale: The proposed workflow follows the same procedure in the same order (listing, event, ticket count, time/ticket option, Reserve Now), but it makes the date a non-parameter and treats city as optional, and it names "event" and "time slot" as parameters where the true workflow has none; a browser automation would be partly underspecified without a date input or a concrete way to reach the listing.
